university.name: Aston University
university.summary: A university with a campus in the centre of Birmingham, teaching business, computing, engineering and other subjects. It has a Pakistan country page with grade equivalents, a Pakistan regional manager, and a published list of international scholarships with 2027 entry terms.
university.eligibility_note: Listed on the gov.uk register of licensed student sponsors (Student route, status Student Sponsor - Track Record)

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years, or 4 years with the optional placement year
courses.overview: A degree in computing with a first year in mathematics, programming, systems and cybersecurity, a second year in software engineering and team project work, and a final-year individual project with option groups including language processing and cloud computing.
highlights: Final year core: Individual Project (45 credits)
Final year optional: Natural Language Processing
courses.academic_requirements: A levels: BBB in any subject, or BBC including one STEM subject. IB: 31 points with 5, 5, 5 at Higher Level, or 29 with 5, 5, 4 including one STEM subject. GCSE English Language or Literature and Mathematics at grade C/4. International students can enter Year 2 after an approved Year 1 programme with ONCAMPUS Aston or NCUK.
courses.english_requirements: The course page gives no test scores and refers to Aston's separate English language requirements page, which sets scores by school and programme group without naming this course.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states that applicants with HSSC/HSC, Intermediate Certificate or FA/FSc must first complete an International Foundation Programme or International Year One to progress to a Bachelor's degree.
courses.career_notes: Listed roles include graduate programmer, software developer, systems analyst and consultant.
courses.notes: English scores left null: the course page names the School of Computer Science and Digital Technologies, which does not appear by name in Aston's English requirements table. Placement year fee shown is 2,500 GBP but the page says the 2027 figure was due to be updated.

courses.title: Mechanical Engineering
courses.duration_text: 3 years, or 4 years with the optional placement year
courses.overview: A three-year engineering degree with a fixed curriculum covering design, materials, thermofluids, dynamics and control, an integrated design project in year two, and a major project in the final year. An optional placement year can be added.
highlights: Year 2 core: Integrated Design Project (30 credits)
Final year core: Engineering Major Project (30 credits)
Optional placement year: Integrated Placement Year
courses.academic_requirements: A levels: BBC including Maths and one other STEM subject. IB: 29 points overall with 5, 5, 4 at Higher Level, including Maths and another STEM subject. GCSE English Language or Literature and Mathematics at grade C/4. Year 3 entry is not considered.
courses.english_requirements: The course page gives no test scores and refers to Aston's separate English language requirements page, which sets scores by school and programme group without naming this course.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states that applicants with HSSC/HSC, Intermediate Certificate or FA/FSc must first complete an International Foundation Programme or International Year One to progress to a Bachelor's degree.
courses.career_notes: Listed roles include graduate mechanical engineer, development engineer, design engineer and project manager.
courses.uk_min_alevels: BBC including Maths and one other STEM subject
courses.notes: English scores left null because the course page does not state its school in terms matching Aston's English requirements table. The English page lists Engineering and Physical Sciences undergraduate entry as IELTS 6.0 overall with 5.5 in each skill, but this was not confirmed to apply to this course.

courses.title: Accounting and Finance
courses.duration_text: 4 years including an integrated placement year (international students may opt out of the placement)
courses.overview: An accounting and finance degree taught by Aston Business School, with core financial and management accounting, taxation and audit, an integrated placement year, and a final year that includes a consulting challenge. The fee shown is for the first year.
highlights: Final year core: The Consulting Challenge
courses.academic_requirements: A levels: BBB. IB: 31 points with 5, 5, 5 in three Higher Level subjects, plus Standard Level 5 in Mathematics and English Language. GCSE Maths grade B/5 and English Language or Literature grade C/4. International students can enter Year 2 after an approved Year 1 with ONCAMPUS Aston or NCUK.
courses.english_requirements: Aston English requirements page, undergraduate, Aston Business School: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, two bands at 5.5 and others 6.0 or above. PTE Academic 67 overall, two bands at 59 and others 64 or above. Duolingo 120 overall, two bands at 100 and others 110 or above. The course page itself lists no scores.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states that applicants with HSSC/HSC, Intermediate Certificate or FA/FSc must first complete an International Foundation Programme or International Year One to progress to a Bachelor's degree.
courses.career_notes: Listed roles include accountant associate, commercial analyst, auditor, tax analyst and risk consultant. The page mentions possible exemptions from CIMA, ACCA and ICAEW.
courses.notes: English scores come from Aston's school-level English page (Aston Business School), because the course page lists none. TOEFL scores on that page are on two scales depending on test date, so min_toefl is left null.

courses.title: Business Analytics
courses.overview: A one-year master's from Aston Business School covering decision models, programming for data analytics, descriptive and predictive analytics, and consultancy, followed by a 45-credit independent project.
highlights: Optional: Machine Learning for Business Analytics
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:2 (lower second-class honours) degree or equivalent, with quantitative bachelor's modules (such as Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance or Computer Science) passed at a minimum mark of 60%. A reference and official transcript are required.
courses.english_requirements: Aston English requirements page, postgraduate taught, Aston Business School: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, one band at 5.5 minimum and others 6.0 or above. PTE Academic 67 overall, one band at 59 minimum and others 64 or above. Duolingo 120 overall, one band at 100 minimum and others 110 or above. A conditional route at IELTS 6.0 overall with mandatory in-sessional English is also listed. The course page itself lists no scores.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page requires a Bachelor's degree from a recognised university, assessed by percentage first and CGPA where no percentage exists. Grade equivalents depend on a university tier: Tier 1 is 2:1 at 60% or CGPA 2.8 and 2:2 at 55% or CGPA 2.6; Tier 2 is 2:1 at 70% or CGPA 3.0 and 2:2 at 60% or CGPA 2.8; Tier 3 is 2:1 at 80% or CGPA 3.4 and 2:2 at 70% or CGPA 3.2. Applicants who fall short can consider the Master's Foundation Programme.
courses.career_notes: Listed roles include business analyst, business intelligence analyst, strategy analyst and credit risk analyst.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: 25,500 GBP is the 2026/27 fee; the page says increases will not exceed 6% year on year. The Pakistan tier table does not say which Pakistani universities sit in which tier on the page read, so pk_min_percent and pk_min_cgpa are left null. Page also lists January 2027 and April 2027 starts.

scholarships.name: International Community Scholarship (Postgraduate), September 2027
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,500 off tuition fees, first year only
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition discount for self-funded overseas-fee students entering a full-time on-campus postgraduate taught course in Birmingham in September 2027. Paying the deposit by the date in the offer letter triggers the award.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee status; full-time on-campus postgraduate taught course; self-funded. Excludes MBA, OSPAP, MSc Physician Associate Practice, MRes and research degrees, and students on routes with their own Aston scholarship. Cannot be deferred.
scholarships.deadline_note: No application. Deposit due by the date in the offer letter.
scholarships.notes: Aston states scholarships cannot be combined; students receive the highest-value award available.

scholarships.name: Undergraduate International Community Scholarship, September 2027
scholarships.value_text: GBP 9,000 in total as tuition discounts of GBP 3,000 in each of Years 1, 2 and the final year
scholarships.summary: A tuition discount for self-funded overseas-fee students entering Year 1 of a full-time on-campus undergraduate course in Birmingham in September 2027. Later-year instalments depend on progression and retention conditions.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee status; direct entry to Year 1; self-funded. Excludes nursing, MBChB, MOptom, MPharm, Audiology, and foundation, pathway or international year one progression routes. Placement and repeat years are not covered.
scholarships.deadline_note: Terms say deposit by the offer letter date triggers the award. The scholarships page lists deadlines as TBC.
scholarships.notes: The terms PDF calls the award automatic and non-competitive, while the scholarships page lists it as competitive with an emailed link and deadlines TBC. The PDF was followed; flagged for client confirmation.

scholarships.name: Sir Adrian Cadbury Chancellor's Scholarship (Postgraduate), 2027 entry
scholarships.value_text: GBP 10,000 tuition fee reduction (fee waiver only, no cash value)
scholarships.summary: A competitive award for self-funded international offer-holders on full-time on-campus postgraduate taught courses starting January, April or September 2027. Applicants submit a form and a statement of about 500 words after receiving an offer.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; offer for an eligible full-time on-campus course; self-funded. Excludes MBA, PhD and research, and for September also MRes, OSPAP, Physician Associate and MPH. Statement of about 500 words (450 or fewer or 550 or more is not assessed).
scholarships.deadline_note: September 2027 deadline and decision date are listed as TBC. The January 2027 round closes 1 November 2026.
scholarships.notes: Deadline for September 2027 not yet published. How the GBP 10,000 is spread across years is not stated on the pages read.

scholarships.name: Sir Adrian Cadbury Chancellor's Scholarship (Undergraduate), 2027 entry
scholarships.value_text: GBP 10,000 tuition fee reduction (fee waiver only, no cash value)
scholarships.summary: A competitive award for self-funded international undergraduate offer-holders on full-time on-campus courses starting in September 2027. Applicants submit a form and a statement of about 500 words through a personal link issued after an offer.
scholarships.criteria_text: International fee status; offer for an eligible full-time on-campus course; self-funded. Excludes nursing, MBChB, MOptom, MPharm and Audiology. Statement of about 500 words on positive impact and community.
scholarships.deadline_note: September 2027 deadline and decision date are listed as TBC.
scholarships.notes: Deadline for September 2027 not yet published. How the GBP 10,000 is spread across years is not stated on the pages read.
